title: Module Manifest
description: Spec-compliant manifest for a feature module in the @saas registry. Extends the shadcn registry-item schema with db, postInstall, serverActions, and demo fields.

id.description: Unique module identifier. Must match the shadcn registry item name (kebab-case). e.g. 'billing', 'user-profile'.

version.description: Semantic version of this module manifest. e.g. '1.0.0'.

summary.description: One-sentence description of what this module provides.

registryDependencies.description: Other @saas module IDs this module depends on. Supports version-pinning via ref: '@saas/account#v1.0.0'. Maps to shadcn registry-item.registryDependencies.

items.description: Registry item reference. Format: 'module-id' or '@namespace/module-id' or '@namespace/module-id#ref'.

npmDependencies.description: npm packages required at runtime. Key = package name, value = semver range. Maps to shadcn registry-item.dependencies.

npmDevDependencies.description: npm packages required for development/build only. Maps to shadcn registry-item.devDependencies.

envVars.description: Environment variables this module needs. Written to .env.local by the install-* skill — never overwrites existing values. Maps to shadcn registry-item.envVars.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this env var does.

required.description: Whether missing this var causes a runtime error.

dbTables.description: Drizzle table names this module introduces or depends on. Used to generate uninstall checklists.

db.description: Drizzle ORM integration metadata for this module.

schemaFragmentPath.description: Relative path (from next-app/) to the Drizzle schema fragment file. e.g. 'lib/billing/schema.ts'.

generateCommand.description: Command to generate migrations after schema changes. Defaults to 'pnpm db:generate'.

migrateCommand.description: Command to apply migrations. Defaults to 'pnpm db:migrate'.

routes.description: Next.js App Router route segments this module adds. Used to generate uninstall checklists.

items.description: Route segment path relative to app/. e.g. '(dashboard)/billing/page.tsx'.

serverActions.description: Server Action file paths this module adds, relative to next-app/. Used to generate uninstall checklists.

postInstall.description: DECLARATIVE ordered steps that a consumer must perform after installing registry files. The registry does NOT execute these — they are instructions for the paired install-* skill. The install-* skill reads this array and performs each step (env wiring, db:generate, db:migrate, etc.).

action.description: Machine-readable action type. 'env-wire' = write envVars to .env.local. 'command' = run shell command. 'manual' = human must do this. 'docs' = read documentation.

description.description: Human-readable description of what to do.

command.description: Shell command to run (only when action = 'command').

docs.description: Path or URL to this module's documentation page. Aligns with E240 VitePress site. This is a native shadcn registry-item field. e.g. '/docs/modules/billing'.

demo.description: Live demo configuration. Custom convention for E240 VitePress site (iframe + API demonstration).

path.description: Next.js route path for the live demo page. e.g. '/demo/billing'.

iframeSrc.description: Full URL for an iframe embed of the demo.

apiDemoPath.description: Path to an API route that demonstrates this module's server capabilities. e.g. '/api/demo/billing/checkout'.

files.description: All files this module installs, for generating a complete uninstall checklist. These mirror the shadcn registry-item files array.

path.description: Source path relative to next-app/. e.g. 'registry/billing/components/billing-card.tsx'.

target.description: Install target path relative to next-app/. e.g. 'components/billing/billing-card.tsx'.
